episode.episode_title: What the Minab school-strike investigation says about AI-assisted targeting
episode.episode_description: Bloomberg reports that officials involved in an unreleased Pentagon investigation identified outdated intelligence, staffing cuts and overreliance on AI-assisted tools among failures before the Minab school strike. This episode separates those reported findings from claims the reporting does not establish.

short.title: Bloomberg reports AI overreliance among failures in Iran school strike
short.description:
The reporting shows how AI-assisted decision-support tools can amplify stale or incomplete inputs when targeting review is compressed. It does not establish that Maven autonomously selected or authorised the strike, and the Pentagon investigation itself has not been publicly released.
